integrity: A fully specified 256-case exhaustive finite checker verifies exact signature and action-orbit partitions. A direct pair gives a proof of nonfaithfulness, manual two-agent classification proves sharpness, and Burnside independently proves the orbit count. Independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite deterministic binary outcomes, two actions per named agent, and one-step full exact outcome ranges; complete census only for one through three agents. Does not decide general coalitional frame representability. A close 2026 value-range-hypergraph source was not materially accessible, leaving publication-overlap uncertainty.
title: First loss of reconstructability in binary coalitional outcome-range signatures
